description: Source code for Luxul's firmware container format, including functions to read and create firmware images, handling headers, versioning, and metadata.

methods.name: lxlfw_info
methods.description: Reads and displays information about a Luxul firmware file, including version, header length, flags, board, and release info.

methods.name: lxlfw_create
methods.description: Creates a Luxul firmware file by combining a header with input data, allowing setting of version, board, release, and vendor flags.
